card.name: Inside long rare names
card.fires_on: Word endings partway through or at the close of rare, long words, such as drug names, Latin species names and loanwords. Examples are indigotindisulfonate, gambiense, moccasins and contraindicated.

modes.label: Latin species endings
modes.description: The ending of a species name, such as ense, after the genus and the first part of the species.
modes.example: Trypanosoma brucei gambi<<ense>> Decreased efficacy was observed in patients treated

modes.label: Drug name pieces
modes.description: A middle or end piece of a long drug name or of the word contraindicated.

modes.label: Rare loanwords
modes.description: The ending of an uncommon word taken from another language or culture.
modes.example: deer skin moccas<<ins>>. Their thighs are left bare- like
